QuestInfo.name: Not Quite Explorer Material
QuestInfo.0: Speak with #bSabitrama#k to see if the #bTree Medicine#k is complete.
QuestInfo.1: You got the medicine. Bring it to #bSugar#k.
QuestInfo.2: Sugar was thrilled to get the medicine. Apparently, so was the tree. \r\nSugar tells you that she knows she's not quite cut out to be an Explorer, but she needs to check on something #bscary#k that'll be happening soon. \r\nShe runs off before you can press for details.

0.0: Here is the mystical #bTree Medicine#k that only I, the great Sabitrama, have the skills to make. Simply aim and spray, and the tree shall be healed!

yes.0: Quickly, your tree friend awaits your return...

no.0: I'll keep it, then. It also makes a great body wash.

1.0: You made it back just in time, the tree was about to pass out. I'll just spray some medicine here and here, and... YAY! The tree is much happier now! \r\n#L0##b(The tree twitches magica-- Nah, the tree looks exactly the same.)#l\n#k
1.1: You're really nice, #h0#. And brave. I have to work harder to become a true Explorer, like you.\r\n#L0##bYou'll get there, Sugar.#l\n#k
1.2: I have to do it soon. Something terrible's going to happen to Maple World. I know it. I just need to confirm my suspicions with my own eyes... \r\n#L0##bYou lost me...#l\n#k
1.3:
Oops, I shouldn't have said that. Maybe someday I can tell you more, #b#h0##k. I, um, have to go now. B-bye!

#L0##bWait!#l
#k
1.4: (Sugar scampers away, tucking her hair behind her ears as she runs.)

npc.0: I did all this work to make Tree Medicine for you. You should take it to your friend.
